SOBRE A MOBATO

A Mobato é uma marca que oferece soluções digitais para conectar clientes ao setor automotivo, com adaptabilidade a diversas plataformas tecnológicas e integração a sistemas ERP's e DMS's. Suas soluções digitais visam transformar o atendimento de serviços em uma experiência rápida e eficiente, eliminando burocracias e proporcionando agilidade. Priorizando a satisfação do cliente, a Mobato busca compreender suas necessidades para garantir a prosperidade dos negócios. Vem ser MOBATO!

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Construção e manutenção de pipelines (ETL/ELT)
  • Coletar dados de diferentes fontes (APIs, bancos relacionais, logs, arquivos, eventos).
  • Transformar e padronizar dados (limpeza, deduplicação, enriquecimento, regras de negócio).
  • Carregar dados em destinos analíticos (Data Warehouse/Lakehouse/Data Lake).
  • Orquestrar rotinas (agendamento, dependências, reprocessamento/backfill).
  • Modelagem e disponibilização de dados para análise
  • Modelagem dimensional (star schema) e/ou modelos normalizados conforme o caso.
  • Criação de camadas (raw/bronze, refined/silver, curated/gold).
  • Definição de tabelas, particionamento, índices e estratégias de performance/custo.
  • Publicação de datasets “prontos para consumo” por BI, produtos e ciência de dados.
  • Garantia de qualidade, confiabilidade e observabilidade
  • Testes de dados (validação de schema, null checks, ranges, integridade referencial).
  • Monitoramento de pipelines (SLA, latência, volume, falhas, dados atrasados).
  • Linhagem (data lineage) e catálogo/documentação de dados.
  • Tratamento de incidentes e análise de causa raiz.
  • Colaboração com outras áreas
  • Trabalhar com analistas de dados, cientistas, engenheiros de software e stakeholders. Traduzir necessidades do negócio em contratos de dados (definições, métricas, SLAs).
  • Suportar e padronizar métricas (definições únicas, “single source of truth”).

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Domínio de negócio (entender métricas e impacto).
  • Capacidade de reduzir custo e melhorar performance (otimização de queries e storage).
  • Boas práticas de observabilidade (monitoramento, alertas úteis, SLAs claros).
  • Boa comunicação e documentação (datasets bem descritos e fáceis de reutilizar).

Linguagens e fundamentos

  • SQL avançado: joins complexos, window functions, CTEs, otimização, modelagem.
  • Python (ou Scala/Java): processamento, integrações, automação, testes.
  • Estruturas de dados, noções de sistemas distribuídos e performance.

Bancos e storage

  • Bancos relacionais: PostgreSQL/SQL Server, Athena, Redshift
  • Data Warehouses/Lakehouses (conceitos e uso): particionamento, clustering, custos.
  • Formatos de dados: Parquet/Avro/ORC, compressão, schema evolution.

Processamento e pipelines

  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow, Dagster, Prefect (ou equivalentes).
  • Transformação/analytics engineering: dbt (muito comum).
  • Processamento distribuído: Spark (PySpark), e alternativas conforme o stack.

Streaming e ingestão (quando aplicável)

  • Kafka/Kinesis/PubSub, processamento de eventos.
  • CDC (Change Data Capture) e desenho de pipelines near-real-time.

Cloud e DevOps/DataOps

  • Conceitos de cloud: redes, IAM, storage, computação.
  • Infra como código: Terraform.
  • Containers e deploy: Docker (e às vezes Kubernetes).
  • CI/CD para pipelines e modelos (tests, lint, deploy controlado).

Qualidade e governança

  • Testes e validação: Great Expectations, dbt tests, checagens customizadas.
  • Boas práticas de segurança: least privilege, segregação, auditoria.

title: Médico de Família Atenção Primária a Saúde - Amparo Saúde
description:
Descrição da vaga

NOSSO PROPÓSITO É INSPIRAR PESSOAS A CUIDAR DE PESSOAS. SE VOCÊ SE IDENTIFICA, NOS CONHEÇA UM POUCO MAIS E CANDIDATE-SE!

Referência em saúde, destaque em gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, dedicado às melhores práticas sustentáveis e atuante nas comunidades onde está presente, o Grupo Sabin nasceu na capital federal, fruto da coragem e determinação de duas empreendedoras, Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, em 1984. Hoje conta com cerca de 7000 colaboradores unidos pelo propósito de inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas.

Presente em 14 estados, além do Distrito Federal, a empresa oferece serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental às 350 unidades distribuídas de norte a sul do país.

O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra um portfólio de negócios que contemplaanálises clínicas, diagnósticos por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo. Além disso, contempla também serviços de atenção primária, contribuindo para a gestão de saúde de grupos populacionais por meio de programas e linhas de cuidados coordenados, com a Amparo Saúde, e a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde - Rita Saúde - solução digital que conta com diversos parceiros como farmácias, médicos e outros profissionais, promovendo acesso à saúde com qualidade e eficiência.

Com o objetivo de fomentar o empreendedorismo na saúde, o Grupo lançou, em 2020, o SkyHub.Bio – um hub de inovação que atua na promoção e no desenvolvimento de startups, estimulando parcerias, troca de conhecimento e a construção de modelos de negócio que contribuam para o setor de saúde com base na ciência, eficiência e experiência do cliente.

Como uma empresa nacional sólida, visionária, com valores bem estabelecidos, comprometida com uma agenda ESG de forma genuína e serviços de saúde e bem-estar para apoiar a jornada de saúde de seus clientes, de Norte a Sul do país, o Grupo Sabin é mantenedor do Instituto Sabin, que desde 2005 trabalha ações de impacto social nas comunidades onde a empresa está presente, com foco na melhoria da qualidade de vida, do bem-estar e da prosperidade dessas comunidades, fomentando a inovação social. Nessa trajetória o Instituto impactou positivamente a vida de mais de 1,5 milhões de pessoas e 485 organizações sociais.

Conheça nossos processos seletivos, fique por dentro das vagas disponíveis nas unidades Sabin espalhadas por todo Brasil. Afinal, investimos em processos formulados para trazer para o nosso Grupo pessoas engajadas com nosso propósito e valores.

Fique atento e evite cair em golpes! Não cobramos quaisquer valores para a participação em nossos processos seletivos em qualquer etapa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de enfermagem, integrando protocolos de práticas avançadas e compreendendo os princípios do acesso avançado ;
  • Atuar com foco na prática médica centrada na pessoa , priorizando a relação médico-paciente, a escuta qualificada e a continuidade do cuidado , inclusive no modelo online por Telemedicina;
  • Ser a porta de entrada dos pacientes no sistema de saúde, garantindo acesso facilitado , resolutividade e seguimento adequado;
  • Realizar atendimentos agendados e de demanda espontânea , assegurando acolhimento qualificado e resposta oportuna às necessidades imediatas dos pacientes;
  • Desenvolver ações integrais em saúde, incorporando prevenção, promoção, tratamento e reabilitação , de forma personalizada e oportuna;
  • Realizar atendimentos com alto padrão de qualidade, com resolutividade clínica abrangente para diferentes faixas etárias e condições de saúde;
  • Aplicar os princípios da medicina baseada em evidências , respeitando os valores e preferências do paciente, para alcançar os melhores desfechos em saúde ;
  • Promover o uso racional de recursos , com foco na segurança do paciente e na prevenção quaternária , evitando sobrediagnósticos e tratamentos desnecessários;
  • Estimular a autonomia do paciente e de seus familiares , promovendo adesão terapêutica e fortalecimento do autocuidado;
  • Realizar a coordenação do cuidado , identificando e organizando encaminhamentos quando necessários e articulando com a rede de prestadores de forma eficaz;
  • Manter postura crítica e reflexiva sobre sua prática clínica, considerando aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais;
  • Manter-se constantemente atualizado quanto às melhores evidências, diretrizes clínicas e medidas de prevenção de riscos em saúde;
  • Cumprir e zelar pelo cumprimento do Código de Ética Médica , da legislação vigente e dos regulamentos institucionais;
  • Promover a divulgação da Medicina de Família e Comunidade e da estratégia de cuidado por meio de palestras, rodas de conversa e ações educativas , sempre que necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

Conhecimentos que precisamos que tenha:

  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • Residência Médica em Medicina de Família e Comunidade e/ou Título de Especialista em Medicina de Família e Comunidade.
  • Experiência prestação de serviços médicos remotos relacionadas ao atendimento em Atenção Primária à Saúde.
  • CNPJ ativo
  • Experiência prévia em palestras ou educação médica será um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho:

24 horas semanais divididas em 4 dias. (Vaga para cobertura durante 2 semanas)

Nosso processo seletivo inicia com sua candidatura. Todas as instruções são enviadas por e-mail, e garantimos feedback em todas as etapas.

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO:

  1. Cadastro
  2. Entrevista com RH
  3. Entrevista com Gestor(a)
  4. Contratação

Se você acredita em um cuidado integral, com base em evidências, protagonizado por equipes multidisciplinares e centrado no paciente, venha fazer parte da Amparo Saúde!

Grupo Sabin – Inspirando pessoas a cuidar de pessoas há quase 40 anos.

Somos o Lar do Amanhã!

Aqui na Alea , estamos revolucionando a forma de morar no Brasil. Nascemos do grupo Construtora Tenda , com a missão de construir casas além dos sonhos, ao alcance de todos e em qualquer lugar.

Com apenas quatro anos de operação e quase 800 colaboradores, já alcançamos resultados que nos enchem de orgulho. Nossa fábrica, em Jaguariúna (SP) , tem capacidade para produzir até 10 mil casas por ano — e já ultrapassamos a marca de 4 mil casas produzidas .

Essa inovação permite construir com mais agilidade , menos desperdício e maior controle de qualidade , aliando sustentabilidade e eficiência a cada projeto.

Além da fábrica em Jaguariúna, contamos com mais de 20 canteiros de obras espalhados por diversas cidades do interior de São Paulo, impulsionando o nosso crescimento e consolidando nossa posição como referência em casas industrializadas no Brasil .

Local: Campinas/SP

Descrição da Função

O nosso time de Validação Analítica está focado no desenvolvimento e validação de metodologias analíticas dos projetos de manutenção de portfólio. Através de uma rotina dinâmica envolvendo diferentes atividades, você terá a oportunidade de desenvolver habilidades técnicas, além de participar ativamente de projetos com times multidisciplinares.

Somos uma empresa inovadora de cuidados de saúde a nível mundial com um objetivo: perseguir os milagres da ciência para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Também somos uma empresa onde há a possibilidade de prosperar e desenvolver a sua carreira com inúmeras oportunidades para explorar, criar contatos e expandir os limites do que pensava ser possível. Pronto para começar?

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e validar metodologias analíticas, baseados em normas, diretivas e procedimentos vigentes;
  • Elaborar e revisar protocolos e relatórios e realizar validação analítica, em conformidade com RDC 166, RDC 31, RDC 53 / RDC 964;
  • Realizar análises de estudo de estabilidade, liberação de IFA e produto acabado;
  • Colaborar tecnicamente com as definições de estratégia para desenvolvimento analítico e predição de impurezas para estudo de degradação;
  • Colaborar, tecnicamente, com as definições de estratégias regulatórias para submissão de pós-registro, conforme RDC 73/2016 e RDC 443/2020;
  • Colaborar com a elaboração de documentos regulatórios (análise de risco, PATE, justificativas, relatórios);
  • Elaborar, conferir, tornar vigente e obsoletar as especificações e métodos de análise, conforme procedimentos vigentes e cronograma da atividade;
  • Manter o conhecimento e cumprir com os princípios de Ética e Integridade, políticas da Sanofi e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico;
  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da Sanofi, com objetivo de prevenir ocorrência de acidentes, evitar riscos para a saúde, promover o bem-estar dos colaboradores e reduzir os impactos ambientais resultantes da execução de atividades do trabalho;
  • Apoiar a estratégia e as iniciativas de Diversidade e Inclusão da Sanofi para assegurar que todos os colaboradores e parceiros sejam tratados com respeito e recebam oportunidades iguais.

Sobre Você

Experiência

Em indústria farmacêutica com atuação em desenvolvimento, validação analítica e processos de pós-registro; Ampla experiência em atividades de laboratório e na utilização de diferentes equipamentos de laboratório (HPLC, CG, dissolutor).

Competências Técnicas e Pessoais

Proatividade, foco, oferecer soluções para os problemas, pensamento estratégico, bom relacionamento interpessoal, planejamento, organização, trabalho em equipe, gerenciamento de conflitos; Conhecimento amplo da legislação de Boas Práticas de Fabricação; Conhecimento amplo das normas vigentes de validação analítica e pós-registro da ANVISA; Pacote Office.

Formação Acadêmica

Graduação em Farmácia, Química ou Engenharia Química.

Línguas

Inglês intermediário.

Porque Deve Nos Escolher?

description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.

Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.

At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!

Hello, developer! We have a special opportunity for you, but first, let's see if it makes sense for you!

If you are passionate about providing exceptional user experiences, have a strategic eye for metrics, and feel at home in high-performance, scalable distributed environments, we want you to technically lead our projects with us.

Come to work as a Software Engineer Analyst III. You will be part of our development team, where your role will be fundamental in leading the development and architecture of modern web applications and being a key player in creating amazing new products for our clients. Our team builds products on a global scale with many direct integrations, including with Meta (Facebook) for messaging.

The responsibilities for each role vary, but in general, here’s what we’ll expect from you day-to-day:

  • Lead the delivery of technology projects and products aligned with the company’s strategic objectives (OKRs), actively influencing the product team with suggestions and new features.
  • Mentor other developers, promoting best development practices and ensuring code quality through rigorous code reviews.
  • Define and architect scalable Front-End systems for our robust, global messaging platform (for channels like WhatsApp and SMS).
  • Make architectural decisions and develop interfaces for incredible integrations and conversational experiences using modern technologies.
  • Lead technical discussions, define the direction for solutions, and collaborate to solve our clients’ most complex problems, helping to scale our solution.
  • Ensure excellence in code versioning (Git) and Pull Request processes.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs, proposing improvements and new standards.

Requirements

  • Vast and proven experience in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
  • Advanced and solid experience in development with Angular.
  • Deep knowledge of Reactive Programming with Signals (Angular 16+).
  • Mastery of Redux/Ngrx for state management, including architecting complex solutions with actions, reducers, effects, and selectors.
  • Profound knowledge of system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and the application of design patterns in complex scenarios.
  • Solid experience with agile development methodologies, acting as a technical reference for the team.
  • Solid experience with Unit and Integration Testing, including defining testing strategies.
  • Experience with creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions).
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases.

As we are a global company, English is essential.

In your daily work, you will need to communicate with teams around the world. We expect you to have fluency or, at a minimum, professional proficiency in English to participate in technical discussions and collaborate effectively.

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working in a team with talented people and raising the team’s technical bar by seeking new solutions, challenging the status quo, and improving existing processes.
  • Have the autonomy and proactivity to lead initiatives and adapt quickly to change.
  • Possess excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships with different teams and hierarchical levels, being able to translate technical requirements for stakeholders.
  • In short, we are looking for someone willing to dive deep into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always striving for continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.

And as a bonus, it would be great if you have experience with:

  • Front-End Performance and Optimization: Deep knowledge of tools and techniques to optimize application performance, such as bundle size analysis (Webpack Bundle Analyzer), code-splitting, lazy loading, and improving Core Web Vitals.
  • Front-End Observability: Experience with tools for monitoring front-end applications, like Sentry, Datadog RUM, or similar platforms, to track errors and user experience.
  • Design Systems: Experience in building, maintaining, or contributing to a scalable design system or component library (e.g., using Storybook).
  • Advanced Testing: Practical experience with End-to-End (E2E) testing frameworks like Cypress or Playwright.
  • Monorepo Architecture: Familiarity with managing front-end projects within a monorepo (e.g., using Nx, Lerna).

If you enjoy challenges like designing complex application architecture, creating exceptional user experiences at scale, and optimizing performance for a global audience, we have these and other topics on our team’s agenda. If you identify with this challenge and want to technically lead projects with a global impact, let’s have a chat to get to know our challenges up close!

Our Hiring Process

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward—hopefully with us!

Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future: Our partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end‑to‑end resolution of production incidents and service requests for live digital applications and products; participate in and contribute to root cause analysis for recurring issues.
  • Triage and troubleshoot application, data, and integration issues; document evidence (logs, traces, queries, API behavior) to support diagnosis and handoff to specialists when needed.
  • Participate in war rooms for critical incidents, helping drive resolution and communicating clearly with stakeholders throughout the event.
  • Monitor incident and request queues, prioritize work, and act proactively to meet SLAs and reduce customer impact.
  • Follow and improve IT service management processes and procedures aligned with ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change, and Knowledge Management).
  • Maintain and evolve SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge base content in Confluence after incident resolution and reviews.
  • Analyze incident trends and current tooling/processes to identify improvements that reduce recurrence and improve reliability of the application layer.
  • Mentor junior analysts on diagnosis, tooling, documentation, and best practices.
  • Prepare and present operational reports and metrics to leadership where required.
  • Support onboarding and training of new team members; collaborate daily with engineering, QA, product, and project stakeholders.

What you’ll need

  • University degree in courses related to computing such as Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or Systems Analysis and Development (or equivalent professional experience in application support).
  • Solid experience in production application support or technical operations for software/digital products at scale.
  • Strong problem‑solving, critical thinking, systems thinking, and learning agility (comfort adopting new product areas, data sources, and tools).
  • Knowledge of SQL and of relational and non‑relational (NoSQL) databases for investigation and validation, including hands‑on use where needed (e.g. MongoDB and/or Cosmos DB).
  • Familiarity with mobile app testing on Android and iOS—using local simulators/emulators and/or cloud device and browser testing platforms (e.g. LambdaTest, BrowserStack)—to reproduce and validate user‑impacting issues.
  • APIs and practical use of tools such as Postman for reproduction and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of cloud computing concepts (Azure and/or AWS), microservices, messaging/MQ concepts, and observability (e.g. APM, distributed tracing); hands‑on experience with New Relic is a strong plus.
  • Experience with Jira (e.g. JSM, Software, service desk workflows) and Confluence for ticketing, documentation, and knowledge management.
  • Programming logic and ability to run or adapt Python scripts (e.g. in VS Code) for diagnostics or light automation; broader programming experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Databricks (or similar) for data analysis in support investigations is a plus.
  • Confident use of AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor) for research, drafting, and analysis—with sound judgment and verification.
  • Advanced communication skills in English (written and spoken).
  • Experience with Agile projects or delivery environments.

More about you

  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities during incidents and peak volume.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills applied to business rules, data flows, and user‑impacting defects.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment aligned with development and product teams.
  • High level of self‑motivation and willingness to make a measurable difference in stability and customer experience.
  • Autonomy, accountability, and a strong desire to learn continuously.

Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents.

Role Overview

The QA Lead will be responsible for scaling the entire quality assurance function, blending strategic people leadership with a hands‑on technical approach to drive excellence across every product delivery. You will be responsible for expanding automated test coverage, reducing the lead time between development completion and validated delivery, and defining the QA processes that keep our team both rigorous and agile. This role is built for someone obsessed with quality and product excellence, who brings strong organizational discipline, a comprehensive automation mindset, and the ability to lead a team while staying deeply connected to the technical work, measuring what matters through clear KPIs and continuously raising the bar for how great software ships. This role will report to the VP of Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and coach the QA team, conducting regular 1:1s and career development planning.
  • Manage the distribution of QA engineers across squads, implementing a rotation strategy.
  • Design and implement a robust automation roadmap, prioritizing regression testing to maximize platform stability.
  • Build and maintain automated flows that simulate real user behavior across web and desktop environments (using Python or Java).
  • Continuously increase automated test coverage to proactively identify edge cases and prevent production incidents.
  • Optimize the "development‑to‑delivery" window by refining validation processes without compromising quality standards.
  • Act as a focal point for incident management, triaging bugs alongside developers and ensuring swift resolution and root‑cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering team to ensure the QA process is mature, solid, and aligned with agile delivery cycles.
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) through Jira, such as response times, validation cycles, and defect leakage.
  • Evangelize QA best practices within the engineering team to ensure quality is a shared responsibility.
  • Provide regular reports to senior management regarding the health of the area, automation progress, and product stability.

Requisitos

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
  • Prior hands‑on experience with software testing automation (5+ years).
  • Proven experience in leading and scaling QA teams.
  • Experience in at least one programming/scripting language (Python or Java).
  • Experience testing both Web and Desktop applications.
  • Communicates with clarity and collaborative humility.
  • Drives action with bold decisiveness and consistently insisting on high standards to deliver with speed and confidence.
  • Familiarity with Behavior‑driven development (BDD).
  • Familiarity with test automation tools such as Postman, Selenium, Playwright, Behave.
  • Experience with development of Automated Pipelines (preferably with GitHub Actions).
  • Experience with Atlassian Jira.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion.
  • Portuguese - Fluent.
  • English - Advanced.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

Performance & Insights

Nosso foco é simplificar o dia a dia dos nossos parceiros e impulsionar o crescimento dos seus negócios em todo o Brasil.

Na Cardway, valorizamos atitudes, conhecimento e vontade de fazer acontecer. Acreditamos no poder das conexões e na diversidade em todas as suas formas.

Independentemente de idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual, buscamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos e vontade de transformar.

description:
It’s more than a job

When you work in Freight Logistics and Operations at Kuehne+Nagel, you play a key role in optimising processes and ensuring that inventory and shipments move efficiently. Your work also helps ensure that vital medicines reach patients on time and supports other essential deliveries, from wind turbines to semiconductors. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

How you create impact

  • Customer Care and Satisfaction: Proactive advice and consultancy, ensuring customer satisfaction
  • Shipment Management: Qualification and entry of customer orders into the operational execution process
  • Complaint Management
  • Customer Onboarding: Inclusion and transfer of customer requirements into the KN systems; Accompanying (initial) customer order
  • Customer Data Management: Maintenance and integration of customer data in the KN systems
  • Operational Customer Relationship Management: Knowledge exchange with the sales; Establishment of an operative customer relationship (sales support)
  • Reporting: creating, refining and reviewing reports
  • Coordination with KN Overseas
  • Customer Focal Point: Communication point to customers related to quotations, seafreight and cargo pickup/delivery
  • Monitor internal data and customer indicators in accordance with customer expectation, action plan and continuous improvement
  • Guide and help the team with less experience, responsible for providing solutions with complexity
  • Meet and respect the values, policies and procedures of Health and Safety, Quality and Environment, as well as the internal rules of the Company eligible for all employees, but especially in this position with regard to the security of the logistics chain or compliance with taxes and customs obligations

What we would like you to bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in International Relations, Foreign Trade, Business Administration, or related fields
  • 4+ years of experience in sea logistics transportation
  • Previous experience in customer care within freight forwarding
  • Mandatory experience with import or export processes
  • Advanced English

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel, a career is more than you imagine—it’s an opportunity to grow, contribute, and make an impact. We cultivate an inclusive and supportive workplace where every employee is valued, empowered, and inspired to reach their full potential.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world. As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life‑saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no produto com base em dados, feedbacks e contexto de negócio
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais para entregar impacto real

O que esperamos de você

  • Seja apaixonado por entender o problema antes de sair desenhando soluções
  • Tenha curiosidade genuína para conversar com clientes, investigar contextos e ir além do óbvio
  • Goste de trabalhar com dados e use isso no dia a dia para embasar decisões, não apenas validar opiniões
  • Tenha interesse real em utilizar inteligência artificial como parte do seu processo de trabalho
  • Se sinta confortável lidando com cenários complexos e transformando isso em algo simples e claro
  • Tenha resiliência para lidar com problemas difíceis, mudanças de contexto e ciclos constantes de aprendizado
  • Saiba colaborar bem com diferentes áreas e valorize a construção em conjunto
  • Tenha atenção aos detalhes e se preocupe com a qualidade final do que chega ao usuário
  • Seja organizado no seu trabalho e contribua para manter consistência no produto (especialmente dentro do design system)
  • Tenha maturidade para questionar, propor e evoluir ideias com o time

Na wehandle, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e equitativo, onde todos têm a oportunidade de crescer e contribuir. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e incentivamos candidaturas de todos os perfis.

description:
Overview

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the job

U-Skill

You will be responsible for leading and evolving our U‑Skill program , an initiative designed to help employees build critical skills for their roles and support continuous career growth across the organization. How it works:

  • Define Skills – Identify the key skills required for each role.
  • Assess – Employees and managers evaluate current skill levels to identify strengths and gaps.
  • Develop – Create targeted learning journeys (e-learning, trainings, masterclasses) to close gaps and build capabilities.

What you\'ll do:

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and execution of U-Skill.
  • Define and standardize the U-Skill framework across BEES (Tech & Commercial), ensuring consistency and scalability.
  • Partner with Business Leaders and PBPs to design the 2026 U-Skill structure for both Tech and Commercial populations.
  • Lead the development and implementation of U-Skill new assessment platform.
  • Translate 2025 U-Skill results into clear development actions and structured learning journeys, ensuring follow-through and measurable impact (in partnership with the Capabilities Director).
  • Lead preparation and operational readiness for the November 2026 U-Skill cycle and full 2027 rollout.

Growth Platform (L&D official global tool)

  • Own the evolution of the Growth Platform as the single source of truth for Learning & Development.
  • Drive platform adoption, usability, and continuous improvement.
  • Define and track key KPIs to measure engagement, usage, and impact on performance.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with the Communications team to ensure simple, clear, and consistent messaging.
  • Act as a key collaborator across Business, HRBPs, and Capabilities, enabling alignment and speed.

What you\'ll need

  • Advanced English
  • Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills
  • Strategic thinking
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills
  • Adaptability and agility in fast-changing environments
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Analytical mindset with comfort using data to drive decisions
  • High sense of ownership and accountability.

What We Offer

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action

AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Toradex is looking for an Information Security & Compliance Specialist to strengthen our Digital Business Operations group.

In this role, you will be the driving force behind the day-to-day operation and continual improvement of our Information Security Management System (ISMS) . You will prepare the organization for internal audits and surveillance audits, ensuring we maintain and evolve our ISO/ IEC 27001 implementation. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you will translate security requirements into practical processes, controls, and documentation that support our digital business.

About you

  • You enjoy solving problems and taking on difficult challenges.
  • If you don’t know the answer, you will dig until you find it.
  • Communicate clearly and concisely with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders. You write documentation well.
  • You are motivated and driven. You volunteer for new challenges without waiting to be asked. You will take ownership of the time you spend with us and make a difference.
  • Appreciate standards and processes, but also know when a pragmatic approach is needed.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and maintain the Toradex Information Security Management System (ISMS) on a daily basis
  • Coordinate and support all activities related to our ISO/ IEC 27001 implementation and continuous improvement
  • Plan, prepare, and support internal audits, surveillance audits, and recertification audits
  • Perform and/or coordinate internal ISMS audits across relevant functions and locations
  • Monitor the status of information security controls, collect evidence, and maintain required documentation
  • Support risk assessments, treatment plans, and follow‑up of mitigation actions
  • Maintain and improve information security policies, procedures, and guidelines
  • Track non‑conformities, incidents, and corrective actions, ensuring timely resolution
  • Collaborate with IT, Engineering, HR, Legal and other stakeholders to embed security into daily operations
  • Support information security awareness and training activities within the company
  • Monitor changes in relevant standards, regulatory, and customer requirements and reflect them in the ISMS
  • Provide regular reporting on ISMS status, risks, and improvements to management

Qualifications and Experience

  • A completed bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Experience working with an Information Security Management System (ISMS), ideally in an ISO/ IEC 27001 environment
  • Solid understanding of core information security principles (confidentiality, integrity, availability, risk management)
  • Hands‑on experience with audits (internal or external), ideally in an IT or technology‑driven organization
  • Familiarity with common IT environments (cloud services, networks, endpoints, identity and access management)
  • Efficient work tracking, documenting and management skills (Jira, Confluence)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Fluency in English both written and spoken is a must
  • Available to work a few days a week from Toradex Office in Campinas/SP

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Disclaimer: This is not a temporary role. It is a long-term, full-time opportunity.

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Como Application Service Manager (ASM), você será o guardião da estabilidade, performance e governança do ecossistema de aplicações corporativas globais. Essa função combina liderança técnica, gestão de fornecedores, controle financeiro e garantia de excelência operacional, assegurando que as aplicações entreguem valor, cumpram SLAs e operem com máxima eficiência.

Toradex’s Brazil office hosts parts of the Global Sales, Marketing, and R&D teams, composed of several engineers working on diverse tasks with global reach. Toradex teams are mission-oriented, high-performing collaborative, and empowered to innovate & improve products & services (including open-source projects) for the benefit of our customers and the industry.

Job Description

As a Torizon Cloud Backend Engineer, you will work with other members of a small geographically distributed team to build and maintain all aspects of the Torizon Cloud product. You will have a high level of autonomy and impact on the product. You will closely collaborate with other teams in R&D to release cross-team products.

  • Programming language experience: Scala, Golang

  • Strong proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Strong Scala experience, or experience with other functional programming languages.
  • Experience designing/architecting software systems in a micro-service architecture.
  • Experience developing applications in a micro-service architecture.
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, IaC, and Container technologies.
  • Experience with Kafka, MQTT, and various other message-bus systems.
  • Experience creating a REST API.
  • Experience creating CICD pipelines.
  • Proven passion for learning new technologies and exploring new frameworks.
  • Passion for end-to-end problem solving and working collaboratively with others.
  • Maintainer of open-source project.

What we Offer

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest cloud technologies in an international environment
  • Learning state of the art technology in a fast-paced environment
  • Mentorship from senior team-members
  • Opportunity to be part of industry disruptive technology
  • Work alongside a close-knit, respectful, and fun team
  • Flexible working schedule
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Desired Candidate Profile

Toradex is a dynamic, fun and exciting work environment. We are looking for somebody who has similar values, is passionate about their work, and motivated to learn new things. We try to constantly improve and expect the same from you. The cloud team is a geographically distributed team which requires a high level of communication and autonomy, the candidate is expected to be a "self starter" and be capable of managing ones time effectively.

description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável pelo monitoramento, operação e manutenção dos Sistema de Automação, limitados aos de média complexidade, compreendido por sistema de iluminação, ar condicionado, manutenção, sistema de proteção de descargas atmosféricas e outros sistemas digitais/analógicos dos empreendimentos, visando assegurar o pleno funcionamento das instalações, dentro de normas técnicas e padrões mínimos de segurança.

Responsável também pela Gestão de Eficiência Energética e Hidráulica do Empreendimento, monitorando eficiência de equipamentos, modulação de cargas, ajustes de parâmetros, consumos, entre outros, assim como Gerenciar pequenos projetos relacionados ao tema.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Otimizar e operar o sistema de iluminação por meio do uso do software específico que controla todos os circuitos de luminárias do condomínio. Nesta operação é feito o ajuste de timer para ativação de cada área do mall de acordo com horário de funcionamento ou outras variáveis do shopping.
  • Otimizar e operar o sistema de ar condicionado por meio do software específico que controla todos os equipamentos de refrigeração do condomínio. Nesta operação é feito o ajuste de temperatura de todas as áreas comuns e administrativas do shopping, assim como medições de rendimento dos equipamentos envolvidos (ex.: KWh/TR).
  • Otimizar e operar o sistema de hidráulica por meio do uso do software / instrumentos específico que controla todos os circuitos de consumo de água do condomínio. Nesta operação é feito o ajuste de volumes / vazão para cada ponto consumidor do mall de acordo com horário de funcionamento ou outras variáveis do shopping.
  • Monitorar e assegurar a funcionalidade do Sistema de Detecção e Alarme contra Incêndio (SDAI) e Central de Monitoramento por meio da constante avaliação e testes na central de operações, incluindo o uso do software específico que controla todos os circuitos. Nesta operação são feitos testes de funcionalidade dos alarmes, detectores, botoeiras, sensores em geral e câmeras.
  • Coordenar e, sempre que necessário, executar pessoalmente a manutenção destes sistemas, assegurando gerar relatórios e gráficos de consumo de água, energia e demais utilidades diariamente, disponibilizando as informações em relação a anos anteriores e metas propostas.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de conceitos e estratégias de automação, suportando a aprovação com especificações de instalações nos empreendimentos, através de projetos, configurações, telas e programações dos sistemas de automação, mantendo sob seu domínio todos os equipamentos vinculados a sua área (inversores de frequência, soft-starters, transmissores, relés, multimedidores, IHMs, PLCs, CPUs, etc).
  • Organizar e acompanhar todos os serviços de manutenção, sejam executados por terceiros / fornecedores ou orgânicos, em todas as atividades corretivas ou preventivas nas instalações de sua responsabilidade, controlando qualidade e prazos, SLAs de atendimento e pré-validando a entrega final dos serviços.
  • Elaborar, Acompanhar e Controlar Projetos de Eficiência Energética e Hidráulica, atuando na concepção e desenho de escopo, nas cotações e reuniões com fornecedores, no controle fisico e financeiro, no comissionamente e validações de execuções e pós implementação / garantias.
  • Realizar Calibrações e Aferições de Instrumentos em Bancada e Controlar / Gerenciar status, vencimento e certificados de calibrações e inspeções de vasos de pressão, assim como coordenar e acompanhar prestadores de serviços de instrumentação e instrumentos padrões.
  • Atender chamados de clientes/lojistas a fim de detectar o problema de sistemas hidráulicos e climatização e corrigir, se possível. Caso contrário dar as devidas orientações para o lojista e contactar equipe de manutenção responsável.

OBSERVAÇÕES

  • Curso Técnico em Automação, Eletrônica, Instrumentação, Mecatronica ou afins
  • Cursando Superior em Engenharia Elétrica / Automação (Desejável)

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.

title: Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform
description:
Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Pricing & Order Platform, a critical system that powers how we price, structure, and execute deals across multiple product ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, financial logic, and system architecture. You will be responsible for building scalable pricing capabilities, enabling complex deal mechanics, and expanding our order‑taking platform across both online and offline channels.

You’ll work closely with engineering, finance, operations, and commercial teams to ensure our platform is flexible, accurate, and scalable, while supporting increasingly complex business models.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end‑to‑end product strategy for pricing and order‑taking systems (e.g., defining how a new product line plugs into existing pricing flows without breaking current deals)
  • Define and evolve pricing logic, deal structures, and financial flows (e.g., tiered pricing, bundled discounts, commissions, payment splits, financing fees)
  • Drive the expansion of the order‑taking platform across multiple product lines and channels (e.g., enabling the same order to be created via sales reps offline and completed online by customers)
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable system designs (e.g., turning “custom discount rules per partner” into a configurable rule engine instead of hardcoded logic)
  • Partner with engineering to design robust, maintainable architectures (e.g., defining when to use configuration vs. code, or when to introduce a rules engine vs. service logic)
  • Balance flexibility vs. control in pricing and deal configuration (e.g., allowing sales teams to configure deals without creating financial or legal risks)
  • Ensure accuracy, auditability, and reliability in financial calculations (e.g., guaranteeing totals match across UI, backend, invoices, and accounting systems)
  • Identify opportunities to automate and simplify operational processes (e.g., replacing manual deal validation spreadsheets with system‑driven validation rules)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align product capabilities with commercial strategy (e.g., enabling a new go‑to‑market model without requiring engineering changes every time)

Key Challenges You’ll Solve:

  • Designing a scalable pricing engine (e.g., supporting both simple fixed pricing and highly customised enterprise deals in the same system)
  • Managing complex deal configurations (e.g., combinations of discounts, add‑ons, financing, and conditional fees)
  • Ensuring financial correctness and consistency (e.g., avoiding rounding errors, mismatches between systems, or incorrect fee applications)
  • Balancing customisation vs. standardisation (e.g., preventing one‑off deal logic from polluting the core system)
  • Integrating online and offline order flows (e.g., syncing a salesperson‑created quote with a self‑serve checkout flow)
  • Reducing operational dependency (e.g., minimising reliance on ops teams to manually fix or validate deals)
  • Enabling fast experimentation (e.g., launching a new pricing model via configuration instead of a full release cycle)
  • Making trade‑offs between performance, flexibility, and simplicity (e.g., deciding between real‑time pricing calculation vs. pre‑computed values)

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building up world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognise the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We’re Looking For:

Core Skills:

  • Strong experience as a Product Manager in technical or platform teams (e.g., owned internal platforms, APIs, or systems used by multiple teams rather than just end‑user features)
  • Experience with complex systems (e.g., pricing engines, billing platforms, marketplaces, logistics systems, or payment flows)
  • Ability to understand and discuss system design and architecture (e.g., comfortable debating API contracts, data flows, service boundaries with engineers)
  • Solid grasp of data modelling, APIs, and rule‑based systems (e.g., designing entities like “Order”, “Quote”, “Pricing Rule”, and how they relate and evolve)
  • Strong analytical thinking (e.g., breaking down a pricing discrepancy into its root cause across multiple systems)
  • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured solutions (e.g., turning “we need flexible discounts” into a defined set of configurable rule types and constraints)

Differentiators:

  • Experience with pricing engines, billing systems, or financial platforms (e.g., worked on subscription billing, transaction fees, or dynamic pricing models)
  • Background in marketplaces, fintech, or e‑commerce platforms (e.g., handling multi‑party transactions, commissions, or complex checkout flows)
  • Familiarity with rule engines or configuration‑driven systems (e.g., tools where non‑engineers can define pricing logic or workflows)
  • Experience handling multi‑product or multi‑channel platforms (e.g., one platform serving different products, regions, and sales channels)
  • Strong understanding of scalability trade‑offs (e.g., knowing when abstraction adds value vs. unnecessary complexity)

Mindset We Value:

  • Systems thinker (e.g., understands how a pricing change impacts finance, UX, ops, and reporting)
  • Pragmatic (e.g., avoids over‑engineering while still planning for future scale)
  • Ownership‑driven (e.g., takes responsibility for revenue impact, not just feature delivery)
  • Detail‑oriented (e.g., catches edge cases like conflicting discounts or invalid deal states)
  • Collaborative (e.g., aligns sales, finance, and engineering around trade‑offs and priorities)

Why This Role Matters:

This platform sits at the core of the business. Every deal, every order, every financial outcome depends on it. Your work will directly impact revenue, scalability, and operational efficiency.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

title: Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform
description:
Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Pricing & Order Platform, a critical system that powers how we price, structure, and execute deals across multiple product ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, financial logic, and system architecture. You will be responsible for building scalable pricing capabilities, enabling complex deal mechanics, and expanding our order‑taking platform across both online and offline channels.

You’ll work closely with engineering, finance, operations, and commercial teams to ensure our platform is flexible, accurate, and scalable, while supporting increasingly complex business models.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy for pricing and order-taking systems (e.g., defining how a new product line plugs into existing pricing flows without breaking current deals)
  • Define and evolve pricing logic, deal structures, and financial flows (e.g., tiered pricing, bundled discounts, commissions, payment splits, financing fees)
  • Drive the expansion of the order-taking platform across multiple product lines and channels (e.g., enabling the same order to be created via sales reps offline and completed online by customers)
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable system designs (e.g., turning “custom discount rules per partner” into a configurable rule engine instead of hardcoded logic)
  • Partner with engineering to design robust, maintainable architectures (e.g., defining when to use configuration vs. code, or when to introduce a rules engine vs. service logic)
  • Balance flexibility vs. control in pricing and deal configuration (e.g., allowing sales teams to configure deals without creating financial or legal risks)
  • Ensure accuracy, auditability, and reliability in financial calculations (e.g., guaranteeing totals match across UI, backend, invoices, and accounting systems)
  • Identify opportunities to automate and simplify operational processes (e.g., replacing manual deal validation spreadsheets with system‑driven validation rules)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align product capabilities with commercial strategy (e.g., enabling a new go‑to‑market model without requiring engineering changes every time)

Key Challenges You’ll Solve

  • Designing a scalable pricing engine (e.g., supporting both simple fixed pricing and highly customized enterprise deals in the same system)
  • Managing complex deal configurations (e.g., combinations of discounts, add‑ons, financing, and conditional fees)
  • Ensuring financial correctness and consistency (e.g., avoiding rounding errors, mismatches between systems, or incorrect fee applications)
  • Balancing customization vs. Standardization (e.g., preventing one‑off deal logic from polluting the core system)
  • Integrating online and offline order flows (e.g., syncing a salesperson‑created quote with a self‑serve checkout flow)
  • Reducing operational dependency (e.g., minimizing reliance on ops teams to manually fix or validate deals)
  • Enabling fast experimentation (e.g., launching a new pricing model via configuration instead of a full release cycle)
  • Making trade‑offs between performance, flexibility, and simplicity (e.g., deciding between real‑time pricing calculation vs. precomputed values)

More About You

  • You're passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You're motivated by building up world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You're creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We’re Looking For

Core Skills

  • Strong experience as a Product Manager in technical or platform teams (e.g., owned internal platforms, APIs, or systems used by multiple teams rather than just end‑user features)
  • Experience with complex systems (e.g., pricing engines, billing platforms, marketplaces, logistics systems, or payment flows)
  • Ability to understand and discuss system design and architecture (e.g., comfortable debating API contracts, data flows, service boundaries with engineers)
  • Solid grasp of data modeling, APIs, and rule‑based systems (e.g., designing entities like “Order”, “Quote”, “Pricing Rule”, and how they relate and evolve)
  • Strong analytical thinking (e.g., breaking down a pricing discrepancy into its root cause across multiple systems)
  • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured solutions (e.g., turning “we need flexible discounts” into a defined set of configurable rule types and constraints)

Differentiators

  • Experience with pricing engines, billing systems, or financial platforms (e.g., worked on subscription billing, transaction fees, or dynamic pricing models)
  • Background in marketplaces, fintech, or e‑commerce platforms (e.g., handling multi‑party transactions, commissions, or complex checkout flows)
  • Familiarity with rule engines or configuration‑driven systems (e.g., tools where non‑engineers can define pricing logic or workflows)
  • Experience handling multi‑product or multi‑channel platforms (e.g., one platform serving different products, regions, or sales channels)
  • Strong understanding of scalability trade‑offs (e.g., knowing when abstraction adds value vs. unnecessary complexity)

Mindset We Value

  • Systems thinker (e.g., understands how a pricing change impacts finance, UX, ops, and reporting)
  • Pragmatic (e.g., avoids over‑engineering while still planning for future scale)
  • Ownership‑driven (e.g., takes responsibility for revenue impact, not just feature delivery)
  • Detail‑oriented (e.g., catches edge cases like conflicting discounts or invalid deal states)
  • Collaborative (e.g., aligns sales, finance, and engineering around trade‑offs and priorities)

Why This Role Matters

This platform sits at the core of the business. Every deal, every order, every financial outcome depends on it. Your work will directly impact revenue, scalability, and operational efficiency.

  • Attendance Bonus*

  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*

Na Odontoclinic, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença na jornada do paciente — e o primeiro encantamento começa na recepção. Por isso, estamos em busca de alguém especial para ser o coração da nossa clínica!

Se você ama encantar e quer fazer parte de algo realmente transformador... Vem ser o primeiro sorriso do nosso paciente. Vem ser Odontocliniquer!

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos.

Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso só é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, colecionamos conquistas como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e o reconhecimento como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Também fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui — um reflexo direto da nossa paixão por servir e do compromisso com a qualidade em cada detalhe.

Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

ALS é líder mundial no fornecimento de serviços laboratoriais e analíticos técnicos.

As pessoas são o nosso diferencial e os diversos talentos que eles trazem para nossa força de trabalho global estão diretamente relacionados ao nosso sucesso.

title: Técnico(a) de Enfermagem - Setor Imagem / Vera Cruz
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar nos setores da Imagem, Ressonância, Ultrassom, RX, Tomografia, Radioblação, Biopsia, Densitometria, Mamografia;
  • Desempenhar as atribuições de competência do Técnico de enfermagem conforme normativa do COREN, cumprimento das metas e protocolos assistenciais e das agendas de exames;
  • Efetuar registros pertinentes a função assistencial;
  • Orientar pacientes e familiares sobre rotinas do serviço, exames de imagens e cuidados após os mesmos;
  • Monitorar diariamente a agenda de exames;
  • Acompanhar o médico e monitorar os pacientes durante os exames de imagem;
  • Realizar a montagem de salas para exames de imagens e procedimentos;
  • Administrar contraste em rede venosa conforme protocolo médico, quando necessário;
  • Reposição de suprimentos de mat/med em posto de enfermagem e sala de exame;
  • Realizar o exame e garantir a qualidade do atendimento.

  • Residir em Campinas, Sumaré, Hortolândia, Valinhos, Paulínia ou Monte Mor.

title: LATAM Engineering Director - Power Conversion
description:
Job Description Summary

The Director of Engineering leads a comprehensive organization of Design, Product, Test and Process engineers responsible for the end-to-end design of Large Rotating Machines (motors, generators and synchronous condensers), Transformers, Power Drives, Switch Gear and Complex Systems for a variety of industry segments. With design authority (under corporate standards), you will be responsible for major and complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within functional areas of expertise, and be instrumental to the overall business strategy.

Job Description

Role Summary/Purpose:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for the Power Conversion and Storage division in Latin America, the LATAM Director of Engineering will lead Engineering on Rotating machines (induction, DC, synchronous, PMM, synch reluctance, and other topologies) and Engineering of integrated electrical solutions (system design and integration, power electronics, automation, switchboards and installation) for products and projects within LATAM or exported from LATAM to many global regions, notably North America, Europe and the Middle East.

The role is both operational and strategic. It demands:

  • Transformational leadership skills – to guide the large organizational structure towards productivity, process standardization & maturity, speed and use of leading edge technology tools;

  • Technical depth – to foster an environment of creativity and innovative solutions, and to develop new business opportunities;

  • Seniority and executive presence – to interact with the customers in Latin America and abroad on complex engineering projects.

  • The role requires focus towards growth on the Latam region operation, and he/she will leverage the GE network, to drive product innovation, technology injections, structuring and cost-out through tools and processes in the areas of power electronics, automation, power systems, switchgears, rotor dynamics, vibration, electromagnetics, insulation, aero-thermo, structural, and both electrical and mechanical systems integration.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • The LATAM Director of Engineering directs a functional area of several engineering departments across the sites of Campinas, SP and Belo Horizonte, MG. Executes projects with great customer engagement and trust. Translates concepts, considers strategic options, develops tactics, and implements change. Creates programs in alignment with the external environment. Participates in cross-functional , multi-cultural teams.

  • Drives team performance to meet aggressive time and cost demands from our customers.

  • Develop, implement, and achieve performance KPIs.

  • Develop a roadmap for building world-class products and solutions, including electric machines, power electronics, switchgears, software and overall systems design capability.

  • Serves as technical expert in the technical community through demonstrated technical accomplishments which may include holding patents, component design and systems design experience, and strong knowledge of engineering design fundamentals.

  • Drives customer project execution and delivers on time and quality.

  • Leads and oversees quality engineering design, execution, and product safety; responsible for the oversight of the related sciences including materials and performance.

  • Provides guidance, leadership, mentoring and intervention, as necessary, to strengthen the discipline, quality, reliability and rigor of our engineering work.

  • Leads interactions with customers on technical issues.

  • Works with Power Conversion leadership to develop and build long term strategies.

  • Interacts with P&L engineering and technology leaders across GE to accelerate deployment of modern electrical and mechanical design tools and methodologies.

  • Works with P&L product leadership to reshape the overall Latam technical strategy and the organizational structure.

  • Provides leadership with high integrity and oversight of processes protecting intellectual property, export controlled and strategic technology.

Required Qualification:

  • Degree in Electric or Mechanical Engineering
  • Strong knowledge of Engineering Design Fundamentals and Engineering Processes
  • Extensive experience in mechanical and/or electrical systems design
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese mandatory
  • Industrial experience in relevant industry segments such as Oil and Gas, Power Generation, Mining & Steel and/or Marine will be a plus.
  • Subject Matter Expertise on Rotating Machines and/or Electrical Systems will be a plus.

Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores.
